name: 76401 · Stephenville, TX
findings: ZIP 76401 (Stephenville) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (59% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76401 (Stephenville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76401 (Stephenville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).
